name: (Eric) Zhang Chen
role: Director of AI and Machine Learning
biography: I build AI systems for healthcare and biomedicine.

I’m an AI researcher and builder. I’ve deployed AI products in hospitals and medical devices, authored approximately 50 peer-reviewed papers, and hold multiple US patents. I’ve also mentored over 20 interns, contributing to research publications and product features.

My work spans computer vision, language and multimodal models, AI agents, and diffusion models. I apply AI to drug discovery, medical imaging, genomics, and the analysis of electronic health records (EHR) and real-world data (RWD). I received my Ph.D. in Bioinformatics from the University of Pennsylvania.
